newsitem.title: USA: Payless ShoeSource May same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Payless ShoeSource May same store sales up.

text.p: Payless ShoeSource Inc said Thursday its comparable store sales rose 8.3 percent from the same period last year.
Total sales in May increased 13.9 percent to $239.6 million from $210.3 million a year ago.
At the end of May, Payless ShoeSource operated 4,231 stores, compared with 4,266 stores a year earlier.
Comparable store sales for the first four months of fiscal 1997 rose 6.9 percent. Total sales were up nine percent to $884.7 million from $811.8 million last year, the retailer said in a statement.
